evals.prompt: Design the MDP formulation and reward shaping for an inverted pendulum balance task, ensuring normalized observations and separating termination from truncation.
evals.expected_output: An MDP design specification and pure reward calculation function with normalized Box observation spaces and distinct terminated/truncated logic.
assertions: Defines normalized continuous observation space bounds in [-1, 1] or [0, 1]
Separates natural physical failure (terminated) from time-limit episode ending (truncated)
Includes reward shaping designed to prevent reward hacking or cyclical exploitation
Reward calculations are bounded and deterministic

evals.prompt: Set up an Optuna hyperparameter sweep for a PPO agent training on a custom Gymnasium environment across multiple evaluation seeds.
evals.expected_output: A Python module configuring an Optuna study to optimize learning rate and gamma, evaluating each trial over multiple random seeds.
assertions: Configures an Optuna objective function with parameter sampling (e.g. learning_rate, gamma)
Evaluates policy rollouts across multiple seeds to avoid overfitting to a single initial condition
Tracks and logs trials (e.g. mean episode return and standard deviation)
Exposes sweep execution via Fire CLI or clean function interface
